verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Snyk reports a severity for each issue, ranks issues by a risk score, lets you ignore specific issues, and runs its CLI in CI/CD. None of it documents filtering or failing a build by a severity or confidence threshold. Sorting by risk and suppressing individual issues are adjacent features, not severity-based gating, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter and gate on findings by severity or confidence so low-value noise does not block builds
